lines.text: Hi, I am Nora. Is this your first time at the art table, too?
lines.speaker: Nora

lines.text: Yes, I am Eli. I moved here last month, and I am still learning where things are.
lines.speaker: Eli

lines.text: Nice to meet you. Do you like drawing, or are you here to try something new?
lines.speaker: Nora

lines.text: I like drawing outside. Last weekend I drew the trees in Plum Park.
lines.speaker: Eli

lines.text: Would you like to draw together on Saturday? I know a quiet place in the park.
lines.speaker: Nora

lines.text: Sure. I work in the morning, but I am free after two. Can we meet at three?
lines.speaker: Eli

lines.text: Three works for me. Let us meet at the park gate by the bridge.
lines.speaker: Nora

lines.text: Great, Saturday at three by the bridge. See you there!
lines.speaker: Eli
